items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: No, I didn't, but I knew a lot about him. I didn't have the pleasure of meeting him.

ctx.x: Oh. No, I didn't, but I knew a lot about him. I didn't have the pleasure of meeting him. But as I said, coming up in those river boat bands, they were natural musicians, sound, color, they were just -- it was amazing to stand on that levee in Memphis, Tennessee and listen to those bands coming through Memphis, and playing, and docking those boats. Oh, yeah. Alphonso Trent.
Yeah, you mention his band a lot. You must have really liked that man.
